description.value: Sopra Sotto Pizzeria is a neighbourhood Italian restaurant on Vancouver's Commercial Drive, serving fresh in-house pastas and pizzas from a wood-fired oven. The restaurant has a full Italian menu spanning antipasti, pasta, and pizza, and is one of two locations (the other in Burnaby). Commercial Drive is one of Vancouver's most cycling-friendly corridors, making this a natural stop on a city ride.

bike_parking_detail: 2 racks within 100m: stands (2 spaces) at 46m; stands (2 spaces) at 63m. Total: 4 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms the OSM address (1510 Commercial Drive, Vancouver, BC V5L 2Y7) and phone (604-251-7586), so contact fields are verified. The menu pages explicitly mark items as vegetarian (v), gluten-free (gf), dairy-free (df), and offer vegan mozzarella as an add-on, confirming dietary options. No website or OSM evidence addresses bike parking, washrooms, water refill, takeout, Wi-Fi, or any other cycling-specific amenities.
concerns: Website contact page lists darshan@soprasotto.ca for Vancouver while the footer and events page list bgonsalves@soprasotto.ca — minor internal inconsistency, no impact on directory listing.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Active, publicly accessible Italian restaurant on Commercial Drive with a live website and confirmed contact details.

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: Menu labels items vegetarian (v), gluten-free (gf), and dairy-free (df); vegan mozzarella available as an add-on on both Vancouver and Burnaby menus
